tasks.title: Verify Replay Logic for New Event Types
tasks.description: Add comprehensive test cases to `replay.test.ts` to ensure that newly defined event types are correctly processed by the event replay mechanism, maintaining accurate aggregate state.
tasks.details:
1. Identify all recently added event types that are not yet covered in `replay.test.ts`. Check files like `src/events/**/*.ts` for new event definitions.2. Examine `/home/devuser/projects/Orcafacil-Monorepo/test/replay.test.ts` to understand existing patterns for simulating event streams, applying events to test aggregates, and asserting post-replay state. Pay close attention to how existing `UserCreatedEvent` or `ProductUpdatedEvent` are handled.3. For each new event type (e.g., `OrderShippedEvent`, `InventoryReservedEvent`), create mock event instances with realistic, valid data.4. Extend `replay.test.ts` by adding new `it` blocks within relevant `describe` sections, or create new `describe` blocks if the new event types warrant a distinct test suite.5. Within each new test, simulate an event stream that includes the new event type(s). This typically involves:   a. Creating a `TestAggregate` (or similar aggregate root used in replay tests).   b. Applying a series of events, ensuring the new event type is included and correctly ordered.   c. Replaying the generated event stream onto a fresh `TestAggregate` instance.   d. Asserting that the final state of the replayed aggregate is accurate and consistent with the application of all events, including the new ones. Verify specific properties changed by the new event.6. Consider edge cases relevant to the new event types, such as events with optional fields or interactions with other event types, and add tests for these scenarios if necessary. Ensure the replay handles event versioning or upcasting correctly if the new events have evolved schemas.
